notes.title: Patch Notes 002 Balance!
notes.content:
We have adjusted the experience required for leveling up. This change should allow you to upgrade more quickly and advance much faster.
Passive abilities, such as Auto Tentacles, have been buffed to make them a more viable option.
This includes "No Nut November," which lets you gain additional points without clicking.

Don't forget to check out Devilina coming next month if you already completed Tokyo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330750

notes.title: Very happy launch day! Lot of people buying & enjoying the game! But...
notes.content:
From a numbers perspective, the game is doing really well!
I know it's in the NSFW genre, but I’d really appreciate it if you could leave a review, especially if you’ve completed the game.

Why leave a review?
[list]
[*] It helps newcomers. When someone discovers the game page, your opinion and experience can describe the game far better than I ever could!
[*] It makes me happy. Reading reviews is like fuel for a developer’s motivation. Even in the NSFW genre, showing some love goes a long way!
[/list]
If you’ve encountered any issues or feel frustrated with the game, reach out to me on [url=https://discord.com/invite/HmyfQrEDfU ]Discord[/url].

I’d also love to hear any ideas you have for new gameplay features or content <3
